description: SCOUT's raster nodes. The Raster Calculator runs one operation over rasters on one grid: add, subtract, multiply, divide or choose, cell by cell, or a raster's statistics as a table of one row. Rasterize Buildings, SCOUT's building rasterizer ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout), turns a buildings layer into the zoom-16 height tiles SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model reads, side by side in one raster in metres that an Autark map draws.
name: SCOUT Rasters

templates.description: One operation over rasters on one grid. Connect the rasters to its input circles, in order; its code names the operation. Cell by cell: add, subtract, multiply or divide input_0 and input_1, or choose, which takes input_1 where input_0's class is one of the codes it names and input_2 elsewhere; a cell that is nodata in an input the operation reads there is nodata in the result, and rasters on different grids are refused. Statistics: the mean, median, minimum, maximum and count of a raster's cells, nodata left out; its code can keep only the cells that meet a condition, such as a value under 1.08, on the raster itself or on a second raster on input_1, on the same grid, used as a mask: a test of the mask's values or a set of them. The output is the result: a raster an Autark map draws, or the statistics as a table of one row, which Compare Scenarios charts.
templates.label: Raster Calculator

templates.description: SCOUT's OSM vector to raster: draws each building's height into 256 by 256 map tiles at a zoom level, 8-bit gray where 255 is the maximum height, in EPSG:3395. Input: a buildings GeoDataFrame with a column of heights in metres. Output: one RASTER of the tiles side by side, heights in metres, band band_1, for an Autark map and for Accumulated Shadow (model.scout.deep-umbra), which runs SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model on it. A tile SCOUT writes no file for, because no building is near it, is no data.
templates.label: Rasterize Buildings
